name: log_connections
description: Enables logging of each successful client connection to the PostgreSQL server.
symptoms: Missing audit trail for connection attempts
Inability to detect brute-force or unauthorized access patterns
Difficulty diagnosing connection spikes or client behavior
tuning_tips: Enable only in environments requiring connection auditing; disable in high-throughput production systems to avoid log bloat and I/O overhead. Pair with log_disconnections for full session visibility.
